title: dryopteris variolosa
intro: Dryopteris variolosa, commonly known as the spotted wood fern, is a species of fern native to Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a diuretic to treat urinary issues and its antispasmodic effects to alleviate muscle cramps and spasms. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris variolosa include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
